summary: 20-year-old male collapsed with exertional heat stroke about 4 miles into a hike on the Walker Ranch loop trail west of Boulder on a 93F July afternoon; a friend's 911 call dispatched RMRG. Patient found altered with a core temperature of 41.3C, cooled with ice packs, IV fluids and oxygen in the field, then a litter carry to a landing zone and air-ambulance transport to the emergency department. ICU care for multisystem organ failure; extubated two days later and expected to make a full recovery.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County ranger; fire/EMS medics; air ambulance
notes: Date approximate: July 2019 per the Meridian case report; listed as first of month.
